lines.beaver: 어제 행사 준비하느라 정말 고생 많았죠?
lines.beaver_en: You worked really hard preparing the event yesterday, right?
lines.beaver_roman: eoje haengsa junbihaneura jeongmal gosaeng manatjjyo?
lines.en: Yes, I almost fell at the event venue.

lines.learner: 풍선을 들고 가다가 계단을 못 봤어요.
lines.en: I was carrying balloons and didn't see the stairs.
lines.roman: pungseoneul deulgo gadaga gyedaneul mot bwasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Glad you weren't hurt. What about the welcoming party?
lines.en: The welcoming party went well, but the farewell party was a problem.

lines.beaver_en: What happened at the farewell party?
lines.en: I almost forgot Manager Kim's gift.

lines.beaver_en: Oh no, did you get all the souvenirs?
lines.learner: 네, 기념 사진 액자도 잘 챙겼어요.
lines.en: Yes, I also got the commemorative photo frame.
lines.roman: ne, ginyeom sajin aekjjado jal chaenggyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 다음 주 축제 준비는 어떻게 돼 가요?
lines.beaver_en: How is the prep for next week's festival going?
lines.beaver_roman: daeum ju chukje junbineun eotteoke dwae gayo?
lines.en: It's a Lunar New Year festival, so we're making a traditional culture booth.

lines.beaver_en: Traditional culture? What will you introduce?
lines.en: We'll introduce Lunar New Year food and the custom of sebae.

lines.beaver_en: Sebae? Foreign guests will love that.
lines.learner: 네, 세배하는 방법도 직접 보여 줄 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, we'll also show how to do the bow ourselves.
lines.roman: ne, sebaehaneun bangbeopdo jikjeop boyeo jul geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Are you decorating with balloons again this time?
lines.learner: 네, 입구에 풍선 장식을 크게 할 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, we'll put up big balloon decorations at the entrance.
lines.roman: ne, ipgue pungseon jangsigeul keuge hal geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Sounds interesting. I'll help at the festival too.
lines.en: Thanks. This time I won't fall!
